title: Satellite-derived Surface Water Extent — Assam Revenue Circles (Annual)
description: Annual permanent and seasonal surface water area per Revenue Circle in Assam, used as a hazard-proxy covariate (flood-prone surface water dynamics) in the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Surface-water-dynamics covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model; seasonal (as opposed to permanent) water extent is a proxy for historically flood-prone area.
details: This source folder (Sources/WRIS) has no README describing its exact provenance or processing methodology — the exact satellite product and licence could not be confirmed this session and should be verified with the team before treating this metadata as final. Data available for 2021-2023 (Sources/WRIS/data/variables/permanent_water, seasonal_water). CAUTION: permanent_water_area and seasonal_water_area do not appear anywhere in the risk model's data dictionary (IDS-DRR-Assam-Risk-Model/RiskScoreModel/data/data_dictionary.csv) — the dictionary's only WRIS-attributed indicator is distance-from-river (see Sources/WRIS/metadata/rdls-distance-and-drainage.json). These two variables are real data produced by this repo's pipeline, but appear to not currently feed the risk model; confirm with the team whether they are experimental/deprecated before relying on this file downstream.
